description: An online platform for book enthusiasts to discover books, create personal reading lists, write reviews, and engage in discussions with other members.
core_features: Browse and search a catalog of books
Create and manage personal reading lists
Write and read reviews for books
Participate in discussion threads for each book
future_features: Host virtual reading events with live chat
Personalized book recommendations based on reading history
Integration with external book data sources (e.g., Google Books)

milestones: Set up repository, FastAPI, React, and SQLite infrastructure
Develop Book catalog API and UI with search capability
Create Member profile pages and reading list management
Enable review creation, display, and rating
Add discussion threads linked to each book
Implement member follow system and activity feed
Introduce sorting and filtering options for books and reviews
Enhance UI for seamless navigation between books and discussions
Integrate external book data API for enriched metadata
Launch virtual reading events with live chat functionality
